nameOrigin: a supernatural water horse from Celtic folklore
a public exhibition of cowboy skills

pokedexEntries.bk: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

pokedexEntries.wh: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

pokedexEntries.sw: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training.*

pokedexEntries.sh: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon's true power will awaken.*

pokedexEntries.za: By shooting water from its hooves, Keldeo can travel across the water's surface as if skating. It's skilled at using kicking moves in battle.
